integrity: Mathematical proof and independent finite-chain numerical consistency checks included; no external or independent scientific certification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Regular one-dimensional continuous-path diffusions with a single fixed point reset by an independent Poisson clock, started at that point and killed at the origin. Occupation-density local time is accumulated across resets. Excludes resetting the local-time variable, moving reset locations and non-Poisson resets. Known exponential local-time marginal is attributed to Singh and Pal (2022); priority of the new joint formulation requires independent review.
title: Reset counts conditional on first-passage local time are exactly Poisson
